standard-dialogue-collecting-the-window-.player: Hello, I'm the tax collector. Got any windows I can tax?

standard-dialogue-collecting-the-beard-t.player: Hello, I'm the tax collector. I'm taxing beards and I can't help noticing you have a beard.

standard-dialogue-collecting-the-beard-t.npc: What? I'm a beggar. Do I look as if I have any money? Look, take everything I own why don't you?

standard-dialogue-collecting-the-beard-t.text: The beggar throws a cabbage at you with disdain.

standard-dialogue-collecting-the-beard-t.player: Err, thanks. Maybe I don't need to tax you.
